prim.paper: Primitive. Light canvas; inverse text in light.
prim.white: Primitive. Light elevated; label on cobalt fills; text on imagery.
prim.mist: Primitive. Light sunken, subtle border, disabled fill.
prim.silver: Primitive. Light default border, disabled border.
prim.ink: Primitive. Light text; light inverse fill; dark sunken; label on dark accent fills.
prim.deep-blue: Primitive. Dark surface, dark disabled fill.
prim.light-border-strong: Primitive. v1.1: #8D98A8 → #7A8496 (A2). Light strong and control border, disabled text: 3.03–3.77:1.
prim.cobalt-500: Primitive. The one accent: light primary fill and selected indicator.
prim.cobalt-600: Primitive. Light link, hover, focus ring, info.
prim.cobalt-700: Primitive. Light link hover, pressed, selected text.
prim.dark-accent: Primitive. Dark primary fill, link, selected indicator.
prim.dark-accent-hover: Primitive. Dark hover, link hover, focus ring, info.

sem.color-bg-surface: Cards, panels, metadata asides, tonal regions.
sem.color-bg-elevated: Tooltip-free raised layers: frames, dropdowns. Pair with border-default.
sem.color-text-primary: Headings and body on every bg. ≥15.07:1 light, ≥13.19:1 dark.
sem.color-text-secondary: Supporting copy, inactive nav, metadata values. ≥6.45:1 light, ≥8.64:1 dark.
sem.color-text-on-accent: Label on action-primary, hover and pressed fills. 5.17 / 7.02 / 9.17:1 light, 7.45 / 9.55 / 11.26:1 dark.
sem.color-border-default: Card, panel and frame edges; decorative. Never the only cue.
sem.color-border-strong: Strong divider, emphasis rule. ≥3:1 on every bg in v1.1.
sem.color-border-control: Boundaries that must be seen: inputs, thumbnails, toggles. 3.03–3.77:1 light, 3.03–3.98:1 dark.
sem.color-action-primary: Primary button fill. Not for text links (use color-text-link).
sem.color-action-selected-bg: Selected nav item, toggled button, current thumbnail backing.
sem.color-selected-indicator: 2px bar or ring marking selection, with aria-current. ≥4.56:1 light, ≥5.68:1 dark on every bg.
sem.color-focus-ring: 3px focus outline at 3px offset. ≥5.65:1 light, ≥6.12:1 dark.
sem.color-text-link: Link text on every bg (A1). 5.65–7.02:1 light, 5.68–7.45:1 dark. Weight 500 is the non-colour cue at rest; underline on hover.
sem.color-text-link-visited: Same as link, by decision: one accent, no purple.
sem.color-text-on-image: Text and icons on color-overlay-scrim. 7.60:1 worst case over white imagery.
sem.color-overlay-scrim: Bars and captions over imagery; video controls.
sem.color-overlay-backdrop: Lightbox backdrop. White text 15.34:1 even over white imagery.
sem.color-disabled-text: Disabled labels. Exempt from 1.4.3 but kept ≥3:1.
sem.color-state-success: Success icon and word. Never colour alone.
sem.color-state-info: Info icon and word. Shares the link hue, so the icon is mandatory.
sem.color-border-button: Secondary button outline. Light silver (1.53:1) is allowed because the label identifies the button (WCAG 1.4.11 needs no boundary for text buttons); dark keeps dark-border-strong.
sem.color-badge-bg: Badge tag fill: white at 55% (6% in dark), so tags sit quietly on any surface or project wash. Frosted, no blur.
sem.color-badge-border: Badge tag edge: ink at 8% (white at 10% in dark). Decorative; the text carries the meaning. High contrast swaps in color-border-default.
